data.name: Gideonel
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Gideonel means 'God's hero'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'gadh' meaning 'troop' and 'yonah' meaning 'dove'. In the Bible, Gideon is a man of the tribe of Manasseh, who becomes a judge and a military leader of the Israelites.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes bravery, leadership, and faith in God.

in_hebrew.name: גידאונל
in_hebrew.meaning: גד גבור חיל אלוקים נגד אויבי ה' ישראל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גידאונל הוא שם שמורכב מ'גיד' ו'אל', המייצגים את גד גבור חיל אלוקים, נגד אויבי ה' ישראל. השם נגזר מהשורש 'גד' שפירושו מזל, והשם 'אל' שפירושו אלוקים. השם גידאונל משקף את הרעיון של האל שומר ומגן על ישראל.

in_greek.name: Γιδεωνέλ
in_greek.meaning: Γίδεων ἐλ, ὁ τῶν Θεοῦ δυνατός ἀντίπαλος ἐχθρῶν Κυρίου Ισραήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Γιδεωνέλ, ὁ συνδυασμός τῶν λέξεων 'Γίδεων' καὶ 'ἐλ', σημαίνεται ὁ δυνατός ἀντίπαλος ἐχθρῶν Κυρίου Ισραήλ. Η λέξη 'Γίδεων' προέχεται ἀπό τὸ εβραϊκό 'גד' ποὺ σημαίνει 'τύχη' ἤ 'εὐτυχία', καὶ 'ἐλ' ἀπὸ τὸ 'אל' ποὺ σημαίνει Θεός. Το ὄνομα Γιδεωνέλ ἐκφράζει τὴν ἰδέα τοῦ Θεοῦ ποὺ φυλάσσει καὶ προστατεύει τὸν Ισραήλ.

in_latin.name: Gideonel
in_latin.meaning: Gideonel, Dei fortis adversarius hostium Domini Israel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gideonel ex duobus constat, 'Gideon' et 'el', quae significant Dei fortis adversarius hostium Domini Israel. Vox 'Gideon' a voce hebraea 'גד' (gad) derivatur, quae 'felicitas' vel 'fortuna' significat, et 'el' a voce 'אל' (El) quae Deum significat. Nomen Gideonel exprimit ideam Dei qui custodit et protegit Israel.

in_english.name: Gideonel
in_english.meaning: Mighty warrior of God, opponent of enemies of the Lord Israel
in_english.long_meaning: Gideonel is a name derived from the Hebrew roots 'גד' (gad) meaning 'luck' or 'fortune' and 'אל' (El) meaning 'God'. The name Gideonel signifies the mighty warrior of God, opponent of enemies of the Lord Israel. It reflects the idea of God as the protector and guardian of Israel. The name Gideonel is not directly mentioned in the Bible but is inspired by the biblical figure of Gideon, a judge and warrior of Israel.

historical_references.reference: Gideon is a hero in the Old Testament of the Bible. He is a leader from the tribe of Manasseh who delivers Israel from the Midianites. In the Book of Judges, Gideon is described as a man of humble origins who is chosen by God to save Israel. He performs several miraculous feats during the war with the Midianites, including leading an army of 300 men to defeat a Midianite army of thousands.

In the New Testament of the Bible, a figure named Gideon is mentioned in the apocryphal book of the Acts of the Apostles. This Gideon is described as a convert to Christianity who is martyred for his faith during the persecution of Emperor Domitian in the late 1st century CE. He is said to have been a leader of the church in Constantinople and is venerated as a saint in the Eastern Orthodox Church.
